title: pp.ladder-st~
description: `pp.ladder-st~` is a CPU-heavy stereo “Moog” fourth-order ladder filter that can operate as a low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, or resonant filter. It accepts stereo signals plus signal-rate frequency, resonance, and slope controls; the slope ranges from 0 to 1, corresponding to 6–24 dB/octave for low-pass and high-pass modes. The help patch recommends using `bob~` when lower CPU usage is preferable.
